Staging fields that already alias graph-stable draft buffers records redundant copy nodes into the captured graph. This is part 3 of 3 extracted from #30388. ## Changes - Add `ForwardBatch.skip_eager_input_staging` to explicitly identify batches backed by persistent graph buffers. - Set the flag for EAGLE draft and frozen-KV MTP draft CUDA graph capture batches. - Keep generic capture staging unchanged unless the explicit batch flag or global `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY` override is set. - Add `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY_IN_DRAFT_CAPTURE` as the draft-capture kill switch. - Add focused `EagerRunner.load_batch` unit coverage. These 3 memcopies are removed from each DRAFT loop: ## Safety The marked capture batches contain views into each draft graph runner's persistent input buffers. Replay refreshes those buffers in place, so their tensor addresses remain stable. Generic capture mode alone does not establish that aliasing contract and continues to stage inputs. ## Accuracy and Speedup Accuracy and speedup were measured on the unified three-part stack. `bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a mechanism to skip eager input staging for graph-captured speculative draft loops, preventing redundant copy kernels from being baked into the CUDA graph. This is achieved by adding a new environment variable `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY_IN_DRAFT_CAPTURE` and a `skip_eager_input_staging` flag on `ForwardBatch`. Unit tests are also added to verify these behaviors. The feedback suggests using `getattr` when accessing `skip_eager_input_staging` on `forward_batch` to avoid potential `AttributeError`s if mock, proxy, or duck-typed objects are passed.

+"""Unit tests for ``EagerRunner.load_batch`` — registry staging vs no-copy wrap.
+
+Covers the three input paths:
+  * default: the live batch is staged into the eager registry buffers.
+  * ``skip_eager_input_staging``: graph-stable capture batches can opt out of
+    staging explicitly; capture mode alone is not enough.
+  * env overrides: ``SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY`` forces the wrap anywhere.
+
+Imports pull ``sgl_kernel`` transitively, hence CUDA CI instead of CPU.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+import unittest
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.eager_runner import EagerRunner
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_utils.capture_mode import model_capture_mode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _MiniForwardBatch:
+    """Minimal FB stand-in: dataclass so ``dataclasses.replace`` works."""
+
+    batch_size: int = 1
+    input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    input_embeds: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    skip_eager_input_staging: bool = False
+
+
+def _make_runner() -> Tuple[EagerRunner, MagicMock]:
+    runner = object.__new__(EagerRunner)
+    registry = MagicMock()
+    registry.extract_buffer.return_value = "staged-batch"
+    runner._eager_registry = registry
+    return runner, registry
+
+
+class TestEagerRunnerLoadBatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.fb = _MiniForwardBatch(input_ids=torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.long))
+
+    def test_default_stages_into_registry(self):
+        runner, registry = _make_runner()
+        out = runner.load_batch(self.fb)
+        registry.fill_from.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(out, "staged-batch")
+
+    def test_capture_mode_stages_by_default(self):
+        runner, registry = _make_runner()
+        with model_capture_mode():
+            out = runner.load_batch(self.fb)
+        registry.fill_from.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(out, "staged-batch")
+
+    def test_capture_mode_exit_restores_staging(self):
+        runner, registry = _make_runner()
+        with model_capture_mode():
+            pass
+        out = runner.load_batch(self.fb)
+        registry.fill_from.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertEqual(out, "staged-batch")
+
+    def test_batch_flag_skips_staging(self):
+        runner, registry = _make_runner()
+        self.fb.skip_eager_input_staging = True
+        out = runner.load_batch(self.fb)
+        registry.fill_from.assert_not_called()
+        # A fresh wrapper object, but aliasing the live tensors.
+        self.assertIsNot(out, self.fb)
+        self.assertIs(out.input_ids, self.fb.input_ids)
+
+    def test_global_no_copy_flag_skips_staging(self):
+        runner, registry = _make_runner()
+        with envs.SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY.override(True):
+            out = runner.load_batch(self.fb)
+        registry.fill_from.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertIs(out.input_ids, self.fb.input_ids)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
